evidence.ref: The inbound bridge (.warp/tracker_bridge.py) gains a non-LLM PROMOTE RECONCILER reconcile_promotions(adapter, config, store), a SIBLING to reconcile_drafts over the SAME two injected seams (the WARP-0603 adapter seam and the SpecStore seam). For each intake item it calls the REUSED is_eligible (tracker.py, WARP-1001, the FULL triple: assignee equals the single configured Agent user AND status in the ready-for-dev set AND the repo tag resolves via resolve_repo) and, for a fully eligible ticket, looks up its EXISTING draft by the SAME durable intake_source oracle the draft stage keys on (store.spec_id_for_source(repo, _source_link(item))) and flips that spec's front-matter status draft -> ready via the store (store.promote_spec -> _flip_draft_to_ready, the fence-scoped status rewrite mirroring dispatch.py _set_status). This wires the human validation gate: only the human's tracker action (move to Approved-for-dev, keep it assigned to Agent) makes is_eligible true and promotes the draft into a claimable frontier unit; the draft trigger (WARP-1002 draft_candidate) is the two-leg subset, the promote adds the ready-status leg. No new parser, no LLM call - it imports tracker.py (is_eligible) and reuses the WARP-1002 SpecStore seam.

selftest (scripts/selftest.py, the WARP-1003 block after the WARP-1002 block) drives the offline FakeTracker + FakeSpecStore: a fully eligible ticket (Agent + 'Approved for dev' + resolvable repo) whose spec was drafted by reconcile_drafts (status: draft) is flipped to status: ready by reconcile_promotions (result promoted == the ticket, store.status_of == 'ready'), and the reference FilesystemSpecStore over a temp dir flips the on-disk draft to ready in place via the durable intake_source link read by a FRESH store.

The promote is IDEMPOTENT and FAIL-CLOSED, a reconciler over the durable intake_source link with NO processed-offset ledger and NO second store. store.promote_spec -> _flip_draft_to_ready flips ONLY when the leading front-matter status is exactly 'draft'; a spec already ready or beyond is a byte-identical no-op (input returned unchanged, promote_spec False, not counted in promoted). A not-fully-eligible ticket never reaches the flip (is_eligible short-circuits it). A fully eligible ticket whose intake_source has no drafted spec (store.spec_id_for_source is None) has nothing to flip and is recorded skipped, not promoted. So re-running reconcile_promotions over the same tickets changes nothing already promoted.

selftest asserts: a second pass over the now-ready spec records promoted == [] and leaves markdown_for(...) byte-identical (and status 'ready'); on the FilesystemSpecStore a second reconcile_promotions leaves the on-disk file byte-identical to the first post-promote read; and the no-draft leg (a fully eligible ticket, empty store) records promoted == [], store.count() == 0, and the ticket in skipped, then drafting it first makes the SAME ticket promote (non-tautology).

Human control is preserved by the reused is_eligible triple: a draft whose ticket a human reassigned off the Agent, or moved out of the ready-for-dev set, is NOT promoted (is_eligible returns ineligible before the flip), so a human can pull a ticket back from the fleet before it builds. The promote advances ONLY the spec's own draft -> ready lifecycle gate: _flip_draft_to_ready rewrites ONLY the status line inside the FIRST front-matter fence and touches nothing else on the spec, and reconcile_promotions writes NOTHING back to the tracker (no comment, no status, no reassign - the outbound writes are WARP-1004), so the repository stays the single source of truth.

selftest teeth: a drafted ticket reassigned to 'a-human' (still at the ready status) is NOT promoted and the spec stays draft, and restoring the Agent assignee promotes the SAME drafted ticket (non-tautology); a drafted ticket left at 'In Progress' is NOT promoted and stays draft, and moving it to 'Approved for dev' promotes the SAME ticket (non-tautology). The promote emits ZERO adapter writes (FakeTracker.writes() == []) and changes ONLY the status line (before.replace('status: draft','status: ready',1) == after, with exactly one 'status: draft' occurrence in the rendered spec).

The gate-test over the FakeTracker has TEETH (scripts/selftest.py, WARP-1003 block): the positive (Approved-for-dev + Agent + resolvable repo WITH a drafted spec) flips the spec draft -> ready; three single-leg negatives each leave the draft unpromoted and still draft - a status not in the ready set, a non-Agent/reassigned assignee, and a ticket with no drafted spec - and each is NON-TAUTOLOGICAL: restoring the ready status, restoring the Agent assignee, or drafting the spec first each promotes the SAME ticket. Idempotency is asserted directly (a second pass over the ready spec promotes nothing and leaves the markdown byte-identical, on both FakeSpecStore and FilesystemSpecStore). No live network runs in the gate; the FilesystemSpecStore per-repo roots are the reference-wired shape used elsewhere.
